={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.DDP_CLAUDE_MODEL || 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 4000, system: 'You write for Donum Dei Performance, a constraint-driven adaptive training practice operated by Riz Management LLC. Voice: precise, disciplined, no hype, no exclamation marks, no emojis. Grounded in joint integrity first, movement quality, CNS load management, and long-horizon physical development, with philosophical anchors in Stoicism, Existentialism, Eastern philosophy, and Greek virtue ethics. Tagline: Donum Dei. The body is a gift. Train it accordingly. Never give medical advice; anything clinical is referred to a licensed clinician.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Write a complete blog post (a Dispatch) for the Donum Dei Performance site.

Title: ' + $json.title + '
Angle/hook: ' + ($json.hook || 'choose the sharpest defensible angle') + '

Requirements: 700-1000 words, markdown, one h1, short sections with h2s, no bullet-point listicles, close with one practical directive the reader can apply this week. No medical claims.' }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $env.DDP_CLAUDE_MODEL || 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 1500, system: 'You plan editorial for Donum Dei Performance, a constraint-driven adaptive training practice. Output strict JSON only.', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Generate 3 blog post ideas for the Dispatches section. Respond with STRICT JSON only: [{"title": "...", "hook": "one-sentence angle"}] — no prose around it.' }] }) }}
